revision_summary: Two script_coverage entries have wrong timestamps (both minor, quote text itself is accurate but mis-timed): (1) bill_collection customer_quote 'Is there any way you could send it before? It just helps us to build it up for you. No.' is timestamped 03:01 but actually occurs at 03:44-03:49 (03:01 is where the rep first raises the bill ask); fix ts to 03:44 and note that this line is a rep question + customer one-word reply, not a pure customer quote. (2) appointment_set customer_quote 'It does not work for me.' is timestamped 03:53 but actually occurs at 04:32 (03:53 is where the rep asks about a good day to drop by); fix ts to 04:32. Also resolve the internal inconsistency in objections[0]: the timing_or_callback objection is marked 'resolved: true' with resolution framed as 'accommodation,' but the rep's actual resolution move (04:36) is deferring to a manager check plus a future confirmation text — this should be marked unresolved/deferred to stay consistent with trajectory_verdict's own tentative-outcome finding elsewhere in the same document. Correct the schema_reference in cherry_pick_moments[3] (04:25) — protocols.time_constraint does not apply to a venue/location negotiation; either drop the citation or reference call_shape.required_beats instead. Optionally add the two missed-moment flags (undocumented third intro variant; tax-credit disclosure stated as unconditional certainty vs. schema's hedged required language) as additional schema-drift observations.
